# Hong Kong Blockchain Association 香港區塊鏈協會 (HKBA)

> HKBA is the leading blockchain & Web3 industry association in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area, founded in 2017. Member of the ASEAN AI Blockchain Alliance (AABA.asia). Official site: https://hkba.net/

- Official domains: hkba.net · HKBA.club · HongKongBlockchain.org · HKBA.cc
- Founded: 2017, Hong Kong
- Co-founders: Tony Tong (TonyTong.cc), Thomas Cheung (HKBCS), Prof. Wei-Tek Tsai (Beihang University Blockchain Lab), Jay Liang (GSR Matrix Fund)
- HQ: Soundwill Plaza II Midtown, 19/F, 1-29 Tang Lung Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
- Other offices: Shenzhen (Nanshan, Futian), Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam)
- Contact: info@HKBA.club · Telegram @HKBAclub
- Mission: connect Greater China with the global Web3 ecosystem; promote blockchain literacy, RWA/STO education and industry standards; build Hong Kong as an AI-Blockchain FinTech hub.

## Key Leaders 核心領導

- Sing Wang（王兟） — Co-Chairman · 聯席主席
- Anson Chan（陳燿璋） — Honorary Chairman · 榮譽主席
- Tony Tong (TonyTong.cc)（唐儀） — Co-Chairman · 執行主席
- Cai WenSheng（蔡文勝） — Honorary Chairman · 榮譽主席
- Thomas Cheung, MH JP (ThomasCheung.cc)（張俊勇） — Honorary Chairman · 榮譽主席

- Michael Gaard（麦克加德） — USA Advisor · Secretary · 美國顧問 · 聯席秘書長
- Bill Zhang（張海標） — Co-Chairman · 聯席會長
